name: label
title: Form Label
blurb: Styled form label with dark mode support and disabled state handling.
description: A wrapper around Radix UI's label primitive with semantic font sizing, dark mode, and built-in peer-disabled opacity styling.
use_when: Labeling any form input, especially when dark mode support is needed.
avoid_when: For non-form text — use plain `<span>` or typography components instead.
a11y: Native HTML label with htmlFor support via Radix primitive. Respects peer-disabled state for accessibility.
